lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Real formed bend of about 22-24 deg where the 10 mm joggle web turns into the outer flange. In XY sections at z=-59.2/-42/-24.7 (25/50/75%) the line sits on the vertex of the convex (left, x=-26.6) skin, which is the outer apex. The skin slope goes from 3.3 deg to about 25 deg over y 23.5-26.5, with its midpoint at y 25.3 and the label at y 25.27-25.30. The fold exists where both plates exist (z -76.5 to -7.5), and the line runs from -76.44 to -7.52, so it covers all of it. The flange tab past z<-76.5 has no web below it, so it is not part of this fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Real localized kink of about 18-21 deg where the R30 roll (tangent about 24-25 deg at y 13) meets the flat vertical joggle web (3.3 deg). Its turn runs opposite to the roll's curvature, so it is a formed bend and not the roll continuing. The label is on the convex (right, x=-25.85) skin, which is the outer apex. At all three stations it sits on the V vertex of that skin, within about 0.3-0.5 mm along the skin of the kink midpoint. The web and the roll overlap over z -76.5 to -7.5, and the line runs from -76.36 to -7.59, so it covers all of it. B1 and B2 together form the joggle (2 bends).
